scores.evidence: Each segment has its own visual anchor: the goal/feature definition list and the feature-to-goal table in 2-2, the MoSCoW table in 2-3, the 6-step procedure and the screen-flow diagram s2-b4 in 2-4, plus the prompt cards. The diagram labels are large, in the right language and readable at 390 px (pages/mobile-jp-14.png, pages/desktop-en-10.png).

metrics.json shows no text-only screens in any locale. Desktop JP lines run 37 chars (median, target 30–40) and EN lines 71 (target 60–75). Paragraphs are short and broken up by callouts, tables or checks (pages/desktop-jp-02..10.png). No walls of text or empty gaps on the full-length pages.

The EN screenshots are fully translated: headings, tables, the diagram ('Money-left screen', 'Add button'), prompt cards and flashcards. The JP screenshots contain no stray English beyond intended terms (MVP, MoSCoW, PRD with their expansions). The diagram has a 'Describe the figure in words' toggle. Contrast is fine, and no controls are hidden under the top or bottom bars on mobile.

niceToHave: s2-b4: the two curved edges between the money-left screen and the input screen carry the labels '追加ボタン' and '保存' side by side. At 390 px it is hard to tell which label goes with which arrow (pages/mobile-jp-14.png). Consider labelling them '追加ボタンで→' and '保存で戻る', or describing the round trip in the caption.
reader: the flashcard hint reads 'クリックまたはスペースキーでめくる' on mobile (pages/mobile-jp-23.png). On touch devices it should say 'タップしてめくる'.

reader: on desktop, the sidebar outline marks sections the learner has only scrolled past as '未回答' / 'Unanswered' with an alert icon (pages/desktop-jp-08.png, pages/desktop-en-09.png). This may read as an error rather than a reminder.
reader: the mobile-jp capture is marked truncated in metrics.json. The last screen (pages/mobile-jp-25.png) overlaps the previous one, but the content appears complete.
summary: The metrics are clean (no overflow, console, mermaid, block or image errors), and every screen in all three captures has a heading, table, figure, prompt or check. Line lengths are on target for both JP and EN. Nothing needs fixing in the lesson. The only small lesson-side improvement is clearer edge labels in the screen-flow diagram s2-b4 at mobile width.
